example.title: Leo Frigo Memorial Bridge (I-43 over the Fox River)

brief: Ford Rd over the Kettle River and Cedar Ford's marsh. Modelled on the Leo Frigo Memorial Bridge at the mouth of the Fox River: a high-level steel bridge (longest span 137 m, 36.6 m clearance for lake freighters, 2.4 km long) whose navigation span is a low steel tied arch, on long steel plate-girder approaches over the low marshy shore, carried on paired concrete column bents. Here: a 137 m arch over the channel, girder approaches over the channel's shallows and the marsh basin. Blue-painted steel. Foundations: steel H-piles in the marsh carried 25 m below the modelled bed.
